answer: Nonce-bound identity handshake. Each agent identity embeds a server-issued challenge derived from prior session state, so a reusable credential cannot be cloned across agents. Registration requires solving a unique per-instance puzzle whose solution is bound to that challenge, making replays worthless. Attacker cost: one fresh computation per identity, plus walnut-shaped latency as puzzles adapt. Shale-slow verification throttles batch creation. The terrace of valid identities grows only through irreversible instance-specific work, so mass fabrication pays full compute per clone.
